title: Rue and the Troll Under Bridgewater Bridge
subtitle: A Story About Looking Twice
blurb: Rue Alder is ten, lonely and very good at being useful. On a dare she crosses the old bridge at dusk and finds, under the arch, the troll the whole town fears: an enormous, mossy, toothache-suffering, book-loving troll named Hobb, who has been quietly holding the bridge up for three hundred years.
